The graph.json it tells:

{"version":1,"title":"Password reset in our web app","nodes":[{"id":"user","label":"User","kind":"actor","icon":"user"},{"id":"app","label":"Web app","kind":"service","icon":"server","zone":"backend"},{"id":"users","label":"Users","kind":"database","icon":"database","zone":"backend"},{"id":"mailer","label":"Email service","kind":"external","icon":"mail"}],"edges":[{"id":"ask","from":"user","to":"app","label":"forgot password"},{"id":"lookup","from":"app","to":"users","label":"find the account"},{"id":"send_link","from":"app","to":"mailer","label":"reset link"},{"id":"deliver","from":"mailer","to":"user","label":"email"},{"id":"open_link","from":"user","to":"app","label":"open reset link"},{"id":"set_password","from":"user","to":"app","label":"new password"},{"id":"save_password","from":"app","to":"users","label":"save password"},{"id":"sign_in","from":"app","to":"user","label":"signed in"}],"zones":[{"id":"backend","label":"Our app"}]}

---

The current storyboard.json:

{"version":1,"scenes":[{"id":"reset","title":"Password reset","nodes":["user","app","users","mailer"],"beats":[{"id":"forgot","caption":"They forgot their password.","say":"Someone can't remember their password, so they ask for help.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"user"},{"type":"appear","node":"app"},{"type":"flow","edge":"ask"}]},{"id":"find","caption":"The app finds their account.","say":"The app looks up the account in the users database.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"users"},{"type":"flow","edge":"lookup"},{"type":"highlight","node":"users"}]},{"id":"link","caption":"A one-time link goes out by email.","say":"It emails a reset link. That link works once, and only for an hour.","actions":[{"type":"appear","node":"mailer"},{"type":"flow","edge":"send_link"},{"type":"callout","node":"mailer","title":"One-time link","text":"Works once, and only for an hour."}]},{"id":"email","caption":"The link arrives in their inbox.","say":"The email reaches the user a moment later.","actions":[{"type":"flow","edge":"deliver"}]},{"id":"open","caption":"They open the link.","say":"They open the link, which takes them to a page in the app.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["user","app"]},{"type":"flow","edge":"open_link"}]},{"id":"choose","caption":"They choose a new password.","say":"They type a new password and send it.","actions":[{"type":"flow","edge":"set_password"}]},{"id":"save","caption":"The app saves the new password.","say":"The app saves the new password to the users database.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["app","users"]},{"type":"flow","edge":"save_password"},{"type":"highlight","node":"users"}]},{"id":"sign_in","caption":"The app signs them in.","say":"The app signs them in with the new password.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["user","app"]},{"type":"flow","edge":"sign_in"}]},{"id":"done","caption":"The user is signed in with the new password.","say":"They are back in, and the reset is done.","actions":[{"type":"dim","except":["user"]},{"type":"badge","node":"user","text":"signed in","tone":"ok"}]}]}]}

---

The change the user asked for:

Shorten the first beat's narration so it lands within 5 seconds, keeping the hook: someone can't remember their password.

from.description: For move and copy: where from.

value.description: For add, replace and test: the value as JSON text, such as "\"Google\"" or "{\"id\": \"retry\"}".

patch.description: An RFC 6902 JSON Patch on the current file, each value written as JSON text.

summary.description: What the patch changes, in a sentence.

reply.text: {"patch":[{"op":"replace","path":"/scenes/0/beats/0/say","value":"\"Someone can't remember their password.\""}],"summary":"Shortens the first beat's narration to \"Someone can't remember their password.\" so it lands in about 2 seconds, keeping the hook."}
